name: Orbis
summary:
The mission of Orbis is to transport you to the most iconic, wild, and beautiful locations of the world, but with a focus on locations that are off the beaten track.

Initially we will be focusing on the beautiful Zion Narrows in Utah in North America, imaging some of the more remote parts of the Narrows that few people ever get to see.
